title: The Independence-Preserving Property and Planar Web Geometry
summary: This paper introduces planar web geometry into the study of characterization problems for probability laws arising from independence preservation. Let $F(x,y) = (u, v)$ be a real-analytic diffeomorphism defined on an open domain in $\mathbb{R}^2$. Let $X$ and $Y$ be independent random variables and set $(U, V) = F(X, Y)$. The map $F$ is said to preserve the independence if $U$ and $V$ are independent. This condition is highly restrictive and can therefore be used to characterize the laws for which it holds.
